subject: Polaris Therapeutics: kickoff, evidence handoff & CAIQ Q&A
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@polaristhera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>; Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Polaris Therapeutics: kickoff, evidence handoff & CAIQ Q&A

Hi Ana —

Thanks for scheduling time with us. Per our onboarding checklist, I wanted to propose a short intake call to:

- Walk through Polaris' CAIQ spreadsheet (if you can share beforehand we can pre-fill obvious answers)
- Confirm the SOC 2 report scope and the date range you need
- Agree evidence owners and delivery cadence (docs, diagrams, access requests)

Proposed times (PST) this week:
- Wed May 6, 10:00–10:30
- Wed May 6, 14:00–14:30
- Thu May 7, 09:00–09:30

Agenda draft: 1) Introductions (5m) 2) Scope & timeline (10m) 3) CAIQ Q&A (10m) 4) Evidence handoff plan & next steps (5m)

Attachments: I attached a short SOC 2 summary and an evidence matrix template to show what we typically need. If you can attach the CAIQ now (or bring to the call) we’ll flag what’s missing.

Quick question for planning: what retention window do you expect for auth/logging evidence (90/180/365 days)? That will determine which artifacts we pull for you.

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
email: aisha.rahman@redwood.ai | m: +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2-Summary.pdf (stub), evidence_matrix_v1.csv (stub)
From: Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@polaristhera.com>

Cc: Tim Hale <tim.hale@polaristhera.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 13:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Polaris Therapeutics: kickoff, evidence handoff & CAIQ Q&A

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for the clear agenda. Wed May 6 at 14:00 PST works for us. I’ve attached our current CAIQ draft so you can take a look before the call — we filled the sections we were confident about and left notes where we need clarifications.

Regarding retention: our security team typically keeps auth logs for 365 days; for some operational logs it's 180 days. If Redwood needs anything longer for audit purposes, let us know and we can pull archival logs.

A couple of items we’d like to confirm on the call:
- Which controls require production access for evidence collection (we prefer to avoid broad access)
- Any request for raw telemetry vs. summarized reports

See attached: Polaris_CAIC_initial.xlsx

Regards,
Ana Ruiz
Senior Manager, IT Risk & Compliance
Polaris Therapeutics
ana.ruiz@polaristhera.com | +1 (617) 555-6620

Hi team —

Thanks Ana for sharing the CAIQ. I reviewed quickly and added a preliminary evidence matrix mapping — attaching the CSV. Proposed internal owners: 
- Soojin: identity + access mgmt (auth logs, SSO config, role reviews)
- Michael: infra & network evidence (VPC setup, network diagrams, firewall rules)
- Marissa: app controls + change management artifacts

A couple of notes I added in the matrix: many of the CAIQ questions around key management reference our KMS integration (AWS KMS/HSM) — we should surface the KMS owner on the call to confirm key rotation artifacts.

I’ll join the Wed 14:00 PST slot.

Subject: Polaris compliance follow-up — SOC 2 summary & next steps

Hi Ana / Tim —

Great sync earlier today. As discussed, attaching a short SOC 2 summary that outlines the scope, control families, and what evidence types we can produce for each control.

Next steps recap:
1) Polaris to update the shared CAIQ with any clarifying notes by end of day Tue May 11
2) Redwood to deliver a list of requested artifacts (read-only exports or screenshots preferred) and proposed collection windows by Thu May 14
3) Joint review call (if needed) week of May 18 — tentative

We flagged the following items as higher priority: KMS rotation proofs, auth log exports for IAM service accounts, and the network ACL snapshot for the last 90 days.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2-Summary.pdf (stub)

If you prefer a one-pager action tracker, I can push a Trello/Confluence doc and share the link — let me know which you prefer.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Head of Customer Security Operations | Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0210
